description: A sleek, minimal corporate conference room photographed in crisp, even natural light. The space features a clean white ceiling with no cove or cornice detail and smooth grey-white walls with flush wall panels on the right side creating a subtly textured but neutral backdrop. To the left, floor-to-ceiling windows with integrated horizontal venetian blinds are partially open, allowing soft diffused daylight to wash across the room and cast gentle striped shadows from the blinds across the floor. Sheer white curtains layer in front of the blinds, softening the light further. The conference table is a long rectangular form in rich medium walnut with a strong figure, set on a solid plinth base in matching walnut. It seats approximately ten to twelve on each side with ergonomic high-back conference chairs in smooth warm grey leather upholstery on polished chrome or aluminum bases. A large flat-screen monitor is mounted flush to the right wall at head-of-table position, centered on the grey wall panel. The floor is a medium-toned neutral commercial carpet tile in a subtle grid weave. A series of horizontal linear light bars hang over the center of the table — clean, white, cool illumination striking the tabletop from above. The mood is professional, spare, and rational. Camera is at standing eye-level, approximately 5–6 feet, shooting a three-quarter corner view looking down and across the length of the table at a slight diagonal angle. The lens is a moderate wide angle. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
